Unzip hiraeth.zip, open the folder in RStudio, then run:

```{r}
packageVersion("rlang")   # should now say 1.3.0
library(devtools)
install.packages(c("devtools", "usethis", "gitcreds"))
devtools::document()   # builds the help pages from the roxygen comments
devtools::check()      # aim for 0 errors, 0 warnings
```

```{r}
usethis::use_git_config(user.name = "Gemma Rees", user.email = "gemmarees7@gmail.com")
usethis::create_github_token()   # opens GitHub: keep the default scopes, generate, copy the token
gitcreds::gitcreds_set()         # paste the token when prompted
```

```{r}
usethis::use_git()      # starts version control and makes the first commit; say yes to restart RStudio
usethis::use_github()   # creates GREES27/hiraeth on GitHub and pushes everything
```

```{r}
install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("GREES27/hiraeth")
library(hiraeth)
display_all()
```

```{r}
devtools::document()
devtools::check()
```

```{r}
usethis::proj_activate("~/Downloads/hiraeth")
```
```{R}
gert::git_add(".")
gert::git_commit("Lay out palette images with descriptions")
gert::git_push()
```
```{r}
   usethis::use_build_ignore("data-raw")   # keeps the script out of the installed package
   devtools::install()                     # picks up the palettes.R change
   install.packages("patchwork")
   source("data-raw/showcase.R")
```

```{r}
library(hiraeth)
library(ggplot2)

display_all()                       # see every palette
hiraeth("barafundle")                    # draw one palette
hiraeth("barafundle", 50, "continuous")

ggplot(mpg, aes(displ, hwy, colour = class)) +
  geom_bar(size = 3) +
  scale_colour_hiraeth_d("barafundle")

ggplot(faithfuld, aes(waiting, eruptions, fill = density)) +
  geom_raster() +
  scale_fill_hiraeth_c("barafundle")
```
